Landing at New Chitose? The train to Sapporo takes 33 minutes and Suica just works. But there's one hotel situation where the ¥1,500 bus is the smarter ride 👇

🤔 Guess which situation before you read on 👉 https://japanbystation.com/new-chitose-airport-to-sapporo

We checked every time and fare against JR Hokkaido and the bus company's own pages.

🚆 A · JR RAPID AIRPORT

Six trains an hour in the daytime: 33 minutes on the Special Rapid, 37 on a Rapid, 43 on a Semi-Rapid. ¥1,230, no booking needed. Car 4 is the reserved u-seat car, ¥1,000 extra (¥800 booked ticketless online).

🚌 B · AIRPORT BUS

¥1,500 to Sapporo Station or Susukino, and it stops at hotels such as Keio Plaza Hotel Sapporo and Grand Mercure Sapporo Odori Koen. Pay as you get off; Suica isn't accepted.

🚗 C · TAXI OR CAR

About 60 minutes and from about ¥17,000 by taxi, according to JR Hokkaido. A rental car makes sense only if you're driving on into the countryside.

💭 OUR TAKE

Train, unless your hotel is a stop on the bus route. Then the bus drops you at the door and you never drag a case through a station.

❄️ Winter can change everything: after heavy snow in January 2026, JR Hokkaido cancelled 1,145 trains in two days.
